action_groups.name: AcademicTools
action_groups.description: Save and read the student's courses and marks, and calculate grades and GPA.

functions.name: save_course
functions.description: Save or update one course with its credit hours and grading breakdown.

course_name.description: Course name or code, e.g. OS or Calculus

grading_breakdown.description: JSON object of component to weight percent, weights sum to 100, e.g. {"quizzes":15,"midterm":35,"final":50}

functions.name: list_courses
functions.description: List all saved courses with credits, grading breakdown, marks so far and current weighted percentage.

functions.name: record_marks
functions.description: Record the marks obtained in one graded component of a course.

course_name.description: Course name or code, e.g. OS

component.description: Component name matching the grading breakdown, e.g. midterm

total.description: Total marks available for this component

functions.name: grade_needed
functions.description: Calculate the percentage needed on the remaining ungraded components to reach a target letter grade.

course_name.description: Course name or code, e.g. OS

functions.name: calculate_gpa
functions.description: Calculate the semester GPA from saved courses, optionally using projected grades.

projected_grades.description: JSON object of course name to letter grade, e.g. {"OS":"B+"}

functions.name: record_absence
functions.description: Record missed classes for a course and report absences used vs allowed.

course_name.description: Course name or code, e.g. OS

action_groups.name: TaskTools
action_groups.description: Manage the student's tasks in their Todoist to-do list.

functions.name: add_task
functions.description: Add a task to the student's Todoist.

due.description: Due date: a simple phrase such as next Friday, or YYYY-MM-DD

course_name.description: Course this task belongs to, e.g. OS

functions.name: list_tasks
functions.description: List the student's active Todoist tasks.

filter.description: today, overdue, week (next 7 days), this week, next week (both Monday to Sunday), or a course name. Default: week

start_date.description: Optional first day of a custom date range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Use with end_date instead of filter.

end_date.description: Optional last day of a custom date range, as YYYY-MM-DD

functions.name: complete_task
functions.description: Mark a task as done by its title.

functions.name: break_down_project
functions.description: Create a parent task and dated subtasks for a project or exam plan.

project_name.description: Name of the project or exam, e.g. DB project

steps.description: JSON array of {"title": str, "due": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, 4 to 6 steps in date order

course_name.description: Course this project belongs to, e.g. DB

functions.name: daily_brief
functions.description: Summarise today's and overdue tasks plus courses at risk.
